title: West Palm Beach and Palm Beach weekend guide

Palm Beach County weekend guide.

scenes.text: Need a Palm Beach County weekend plan with fall fest, live music, science, and a Friday sports stop?
Start at CityPlace in downtown West Palm Beach. CityPlace sets the scene for Fall Fest. It is a walkable stop before dinner.
